items.stem: Hand hygiene is considered the single most effective action against healthcare-associated infection mainly because it:

options.text: Interrupts transmission of microbes between patients and surfaces
options.rationale: Correct: hand hygiene breaks the transmission link of the chain of infection.

options.text: Kills microbes inside the patient's bloodstream
options.rationale: Hand hygiene acts on the hands, not systemically inside the patient.

options.text: Replaces the need for any other precaution
options.rationale: It is essential but does not replace PPE or other precautions.
Hand hygiene reduces transient flora temporarily; it does not sterilise skin permanently.

items.explanation: Correct: hand hygiene breaks the transmission link of the chain of infection.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A reusable surgical instrument that enters sterile tissue must be processed to what level before reuse?

options.text: Sterilisation, removing all microbial life including spores
options.rationale: Correct: instruments entering sterile tissue are critical items and require sterilisation.
Low-level disinfection is insufficient for items entering sterile tissue.
Cleaning removes soil but does not render a critical item safe for sterile-tissue use.

options.text: Wiping with alcohol at the bedside
options.rationale: Alcohol wiping does not achieve sterilisation of a critical instrument.

items.explanation: Correct: instruments entering sterile tissue are critical items and require sterilisation.

items.stem: Which TWO actions directly support breaking the chain of infection during a diarrhoeal outbreak? (Select TWO)

options.rationale: Correct: isolation/cohorting limits the reservoir and transmission routes.

options.text: Reinforcing hand hygiene with soap and water
options.rationale: Correct: hand hygiene interrupts transmission, and soap and water is preferred for some spore-forming causes.

options.text: Stopping all cleaning to avoid disturbing surfaces
options.rationale: Enhanced cleaning is needed in an outbreak; stopping cleaning would worsen spread.

options.text: Sharing equipment between affected and unaffected residents
options.rationale: Sharing equipment spreads infection and must be avoided.

items.explanation: Correct: isolation/cohorting limits the reservoir and transmission routes.
